components.name: Finite-precision integer material-curve benchmark
components.project_addition: Represent declared experimental deformation/stress observations on finite integer scales; fit a bounded root-basin/versine plus integer root/power curve family; sweep representation precision; compare its real-data error and parameter count against conventional continuous hyperelastic baselines without using those baselines as hidden project primitives. The current result is a one-dimensional loading-curve engineering benchmark, not a full multiaxial constitutive theory.
